offerings.name: Search
offerings.pricing: Search costs 2 credits per 10 results, rounded up (1–10 results = 2 credits, 11–20 = 4 credits). Pay-as-you-go: 5 USD increments give 1,000 credits on Hobby, 2,000 on Standard, 2,500 on Growth, and 5,000 on Scale.
offerings.price_basis: Standard plan pay-as-you-go (2,000 credits per $5; 2 credits per 10 results)
offerings.free_quota: Free plan: 1,000 credits / month (500 searches or 1,000 pages scraped)
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果（web/news/images/alexandria 分组，含 title、description、URL，默认带 Highlights；可加 scrapeOptions 抓取完整内容）
offerings.note: gov 类别搜索不消耗搜索 credits；ZDR 搜索：anon 2 credits/10 results，end-to-end zdr 10 credits/10 results（Enterprise）；scrapeOptions 按页另计 1 credit/page。
